components.css: .ds-post-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.45rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.9rem 0; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-post-marker { width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-post-title { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-post-link:hover .ds-post-title { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-post-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The site puts the writing first. A warm, steady page and one column of typewritten text replace the previous theme's chips, decorative separators, and theme switch. The layout stays conventional and easy to scan: a name, a heading, article links, and an author note with optional contact links at the bottom. Restraint is the design's defining choice; the interface should recede while the writing and its author remain easy to find.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground with near-black type.
Courier Prime used for headings and running text.
One narrow column, fine rules, and square article markers.
No shadows, rounded cards, decorative icons, or dark-mode controls.

rules.name: Writing first
rules.body: Keep the homepage to a direct, readable list of articles.

rules.name: One typewriter voice
rules.body: Use Courier Prime for headings and running text.

rules.name: No invented links
rules.body: Render contact and social links only when real destinations are configured.

dos: Do keep article discovery to a plain list of titles and dates.
Do keep the warm paper ground and typewriter typography consistent.
Do use semantic links, visible focus, and comfortable line spacing.
Do add contact or social links only from real site configuration.
donts: Don't add cards, pills, decorative separators, or unnecessary metadata.
Don't add a dark theme or a theme switch.
Don't add imagery or icons unless the content itself requires them.
Don't use a different font for display text.
